svg.title: Start Light, Step Up on Evidence
svg.desc: A step-up path: run a sample on the lightest option at default effort, keep it if quality is good enough, raise effort if answers are right but shallow on the hard steps, and step up the model family only if that still falls short, remembering that volume multiplies every choice.
svg.text: Start Light, Step Up on Evidence
Sample first; pull one lever at a time.
Run a sample on the lightest option
Keep it as the task's default
Slower and costlier on every run
CLIMB ONLY IF THE LOWER STEP DOESN'T FIX IT
4,000 blurbs × a heavy setting = hours and a big share of your limit
